_comment: Live market data for the Forward OS / Forward Motion Freight portal. Feeds the dashboard Market Pulse card and the Rate Calculator's suggested-rate button. SCHEMA MUST MATCH the portal reader's BUILTIN_MARKET shape in app/src/App.jsx (mergeMarketData): asOf, blurb, dieselPerGal, spotAllIn, trend(up|down|flat), modality[{type,rpm,yoy}], lanes[{lane,rpm}], commodityRates{}. Missing/malformed fields fall back to builtin per-field. Maintained by Dex (market desk agent) — see _sourcing for what's live vs carried-forward. Deploys to forwardmotionfreight.com/market.json via GitHub Pages.
blurb: Diesel's holding at $6.352 after two straight weekly gains, so keep your fuel surcharge tied to the index and your base linehaul firm until the next print says otherwise. Northwest apple reefer loads are still easing as trucks free up (Boston ~$11.9k, New York ~$11.8k), so quote off this week's board, not last month's.

_sourcing.dieselPerGal: LIVE as of week ending 2026-10-26 ($6.352, EIA via IndexBox/Bluebook search summaries, medium confidence; unchanged from last cycle). EIA week ending 11/2 NOT found - EIA's page snippet lists last release 10/27 and next release 11/3, so the print may only just be out; searches surfaced nothing. Do not read this as flat: it is simply unrefreshed. Series: $6.529 (9/21 record) -> $6.179 (10/12 low) -> $6.276 (10/19) -> $6.352 (10/26). Rejected: AAA/GasBuddy retail, stale-year items.
_sourcing.trend: UP carried from the last verified EIA move (+9.7c, +7.6c over the two weeks to 10/26). No 11/2 data, so the trend is unconfirmed this week; flip if the 11/2 print comes in down.
_sourcing.spotAllIn: CARRIED FORWARD, NOT re-verified ($3.53/mi, FreightWaves NTI ~10/3, now ~4.5 weeks stale). SONAR is paywalled; no clean dated national all-in surfaced. Low-medium confidence.
_sourcing.modality: Dry Van $3.09 / Reefer $3.66 / Flatbed $3.64 UNCHANGED, LIVE as of DAT week 42 (Oct 10-16), now 3 weeks stale. DAT week 43 all-in NOT found. Partial week-43 hints seen via search only (not used to reprice): DAT blog reefer LINEHAUL (ex-fuel) $2.73/mi week ending 10/24, -$0.02 w/w - mild reefer softening, consistent with the earlier 'not rolled over yet' note; an undated Trucker item showed van $2.96/reefer $3.59/flatbed $3.55 all-in, unconfirmed. LTL and Intermodal carried forward.
_sourcing.commodityRates: In sync with modality (no reprice): General Dry Freight 3.09, Frozen Seafood/Poultry 3.66, Fresh Produce 3.66, Coiled Steel 3.64. High-Value Electronics 2.60 carried forward.
_sourcing.lanes: Yakima, WA -> Northeast (reefer): LIVE, PRIMARY (USDA AMS FVWTRK dated Oct 28 2026, prices for Tuesday Oct 27, via S3 mirror, apples and pears, Slight Shortage). Boston range $10,600-14,000, mostly $11,100-12,600 (-3% w/w); New York range $11,200-14,000, mostly $11,400-12,200 (0% w/w). Lane string uses the combined mostly span $11.4k-$12.6k. Prior week (10/20): Boston mostly $11,800-12,600, NY $11,400-12,100. Other 10/27 mostly: Atlanta $10,100-10,900 (0), Baltimore $10,300-11,800 (-5), Philadelphia $10,300-11,100 (-4), Miami $12,400-13,500 (-8), Chicago $7,400-8,100 (-9), Dallas $8,700-9,300 (-6). Easing continues at the Southeast/Midwest ends; Northeast flattening. Atlanta -> Miami: CARRIED FORWARD, 19 cycles, no clean dated absolute $/mi (USDA Georgia origin covers tomatoes to other cities, not this lane); NOT promoted. Memphis -> Atlanta unchanged.
_sourcing.blurb: Rewritten to hold diesel guidance (no new EIA print found) and to reflect USDA 10/27 Yakima easing (Boston ~$11.9k, NY ~$11.8k).
